entry.title: Attention Is All You Need
entry.summary: Introduces the Transformer, a sequence transduction architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

entry.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
entry.summary: Shows that scaling an autoregressive language model to 175 billion parameters (GPT-3) produces strong few-shot performance across many NLP tasks without gradient-based fine-tuning.
